codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of edits page with status filter, status badges, and proper state handling. Code follows existing patterns (entities-page, search-page) and uses existing components (TruncateId, useEdits hook). All 150 tests pass including 17 edits-page tests and 6 status-badge tests. Browser verification confirms all VAL-EDITS assertions.

summary: PASS - Implementation fully covers feature requirements: edits list with all required fields (id, spaceId, author, name, status, opCount, timestamps), status filter dropdown with all 4 status options, URL sync for ?status=, status badges with correct color coding (pending=amber, processing=blue, applied=green, failed=red), and proper handling of loading/empty/error states with retry functionality. Code quality is high, follows existing patterns, and uses existing shared components.
